verdict.rationale: Tailscale's docs explicitly describe subnet routers letting devices outside the local network access services within specific subnets, plus real-world usage of routing to home/office networks and infrastructure across clouds. Community testimonials corroborate reaching remote devices/networks seamlessly, though performance and NAT-traversal caveats exist in some setups. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of subnet router setup steps/limitations beyond general connectivity anecdotes.
